key_insight: DeepDOSReasoner predicts electronic and phonon densities of states from crystal structures while enforcing nonnegativity and total-state conservation by construction.
engineering_relevance: Millisecond-scale spectral predictions enable high-throughput materials screening without running costly DFT calculations for every candidate.
method: Map atomic structure to spectra using atom-to-energy source attention.
Refine normalized spectra through learned continuity-equation transport.
Recover element-resolved spectral contributions without direct supervision.
evidence_signal: The model led all evaluated accuracy metrics for both spectrum types; in a prospective screen of 8,106 materials validated by new DFT calculations, 25 of its top 50 candidates were confirmed to have valence-band gaps.
watch_item: Performance beyond the evaluated materials remains uncertain, so shortlisted candidates still warrant DFT or experimental validation.
paper_title: DeepDOSReasoner: Physics-Grounded Reasoning for Density-of-States Prediction and Materials Discovery
